ACTION MINUTES
  CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION

  Regular Meeting
  July 6, 2020

A.  FLAG SALUTE  Led by President Sanchez

B.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

C.  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Chan, Dunkel-Soto, D. Garcia, Gardea, Messina, Sahu, Tang, Yee, E.
  Garcia, Sanchez

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director, Paul Lam, Principal Planner, Mario
  Arellano, Assistant Planner, Werner Abrego, Assistant Planner, Greg
  Murphy, Deputy City Attorney

D.  PRESENTATION

  ITEM 1:  VEHICLE MILES TRAVELED (VMT) THRESHOLDS
  • Request: Fehr & Peers will present the Vehicle Miles Traveled
  (VMT) approach to transportation impact analysis as required
  pursuant to Senate Bill SB 743. The VMT approach changes the
  focus of transportation impact analysis in CEQA from measuring
  impacts to drivers, to measuring the impact of driving, and replaces
  the Levels of Service (LOS) approach to transportation impact
  analysis.
  • Recommended Action: None.
  • Paul Herrmann of Fehr &Peers presented an overview of the VMT
  approach to transportation impact analysis including background on
  SB 743, project screening, and project analysis.
  • Commissioners Sahu and Tang had questions relating to thresholds
  and when VMT analysis is/is not required.

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio
  recording of the discussion is available here:
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mAST-
  GUGhu3ZUdm3mMkUUxeBaVHx0XKp/view

 E.  CONTINUANCE OF MEETING

  Due to technical difficulties, the meeting could not continue. Commissioners reached a
  consensus that the meeting shall be continued to a Special Meeting of the Planning
  Commission to be conducted on Thursday, July 16, 2020, at 7:00 P.M.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the meeting to a Special Meeting of the Planning
  Commission on July 16, 2020 at 7:00 P.M.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Dunkel-Soto, Seconded by Commissioner
  D. Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0
  Ayes:  Chan, Dunkel-Soto, D. Garcia, Gardea, Messina, Sahu,
  Tang, Yee, E. Garcia, Sanchez
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio
  recording of the discussion is available here:
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mAST-
  GUGhu3ZUdm3mMkUUxeBaVHx0XKp/view

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  Due to technical difficulties, the meeting was adjourned at 7:43 P.M. and continued to
  the Special Meeting of the Planning Commission of July 16, 2020, at 7:00 P.M.

  _______________________________
  Allan Sanchez
